description: This file defines a Collector class responsible for synchronizing data items in the Notesnook project, including methods for checking unsynced changes and collecting items for sync, with encryption and database updates.

classes.name: Collector
classes.description: A class responsible for collecting and managing synchronization of data items, including checking for unsynced changes and generating sync transfer items.

methods.name: hasUnsyncedChanges
methods.description: Checks if there are any unsynced changes across all sync item types.

methods.name: collect
methods.description: Asynchronously collects chunks of items to be synchronized, encrypts them, and updates their sync status in the database.
